answer: Every account migration opens a public challenge window during which anyone can submit proof that the migration is fraudulent, such as a conflicting signature from the old key. A Sybil operator attempting a hostile takeover risks exposure and a slashed bond, while honest migrations pass quietly once the window closes unchallenged. A knoll out of place triggers the audit: the account is frozen until its proof clears. When the velvet settles over the forge, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
